_provenance: Indicative NATIONAL bank-holiday list for 2026, hand-entered. Indian bank holidays vary substantially BY STATE under the Negotiable Instruments Act; this list is national-only and is used solely for date arithmetic in a synthetic demo. Do not use for production scheduling.
_weekly_rule: Indian banks are also closed every Sunday and on the 2nd and 4th Saturday of each month. That rule is applied programmatically in grace/signals/holidays.py, not listed here.
